summary: Add central profile-aware error knowledge service and CLI
description: Move the incident/fix database engine into Hermes core. Store through get_hermes_home() under state/error-knowledge, expose supported Hermes CLI operations, preserve the existing database contract, and prove profile isolation, redaction, deduplication, regression reopening, verified resolution and JSONL export.
acceptance: Hermes owns the canonical incident engine and resolves the database path through get_hermes_home().
CLI supports search, record, resolve, list, stats and JSONL export without depending on a user skill directory.
Existing errors.sqlite3 remains readable and writable without data loss or schema fork.
Tests prove profile isolation, secure permissions, redaction, stable deduplication, regression reopening and complete-resolution enforcement.

review_history.evidence: Reviewed profile isolation, schema compatibility, secret redaction, CLI packaging, concurrent writes, and runtime readback. Initial installed-entrypoint defect was fixed; no remaining blocking findings.
